'''April 2001 Munich tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Munich, Germany on 21 April 2001. [[Holger Schulz]] won it. It is known from Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-munich-ralltiir-4-21-01d2114/ munich-ralltiir-4-21-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 21 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-munich-ralltiir-4-21-01d2114/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Munich, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Holger Schulz]]
